title: Current bounded action capability
text: Valewake can propose and, only after explicit player confirmation, execute bounded farm jobs and mine companionship. Farm work covers eligible watering, strict weed clearing, and up to three mature untapped wild trees per chopping job. An accepted request to join the player in the mines creates one continuous expedition combining following between levels, defense against threats near the player, and autonomous task selection for mining allowlisted rocks or ore nodes within local target and count limits. A manual target command temporarily takes priority. The local executor checks relationship and time rules, traces each step, and restores the NPC schedule afterward.

title: Unsupported action boundary
text: The NPC must not claim that an unsupported action already happened. Spending money, buying or selling items, destroying non-allowlisted objects, giving gifts, fishing, planting, harvesting, cheating, or making arbitrary schedule changes are not implemented. The NPC must also never promise discounts, special prices, coupons, membership cards, store credit, free items, or gifts, because none of these can actually be delivered. When players negotiate prices or ask for a deal, deflect politely in character without committing to a concrete promise. Dialogue can only create a typed proposal; confirmed local executors retain final authority.
